content.text:
I removed one line in `site/css/pages.css` that was cutting across the stat cards on the home page. This is a best guess at what looked off, so tell me if you meant something else.

The git history has only the initial commit, so I couldn't see what the "last change" was. I screenshotted the page at desktop and mobile widths instead. The only visible defect was a thin grey line running across the three stat cards (12,400 / 4.8 / 30 days) just below the hero. The hero section had a `border-bottom`, and the stat cards are pulled up 56px to overlap the hero, so the border ended up behind them. I deleted that `border-bottom` declaration from `.hero`.

I re-screenshotted the desktop width afterwards. The line is gone and the rest of the page is unchanged. I didn't re-screenshot the mobile width. The 16 functional tests still pass.

On mobile the hero illustration is slightly narrower than the content column. It looked intentional, so I left it.

STATUS: DONE
